children: Voting for OIP-4 has opened on Onyx governance, putting a definitive agreement to acquire Chain Technology and its intellectual property in front of the community. stXCN holders can cast votes on the proposal, which would transfer Chain's technology and IP to the protocol for use in a blockchain-native neobank. The outcome decides whether the acquisition proceeds.

Because OIP-4 defines a core strategic pivot, the vote gives stXCN holders direct control over the protocol's product direction. A passed proposal would shift Onyx toward operating a blockchain-native neobank built on the acquired technology, while a rejected one keeps the current roadmap in place.

The result acts as a binary repricing catalyst since the market can evaluate the protocol on either its existing product set or the acquired Chain technology. Holders who want a say need staked XCN before casting a vote.
Technology and Intellectual Property will open in approximately 24 hours🗳️

title: Onyxcoin: OIP-4 Voting Opens on Chain Technology Acquisition - By 02 Sep 2026
